training_method.rep_rule: Choose the heaviest practical load that permits at least 10 clean reps; continue beyond 10 until failure. Ten is a minimum reference, not a cap.
training_method.failure_definition: Stop when another clean concentric repetition cannot be completed. For RDL and other technically sensitive free-weight movements, stop at technical failure before form degrades.
training_method.next_session_load_rule: If failure occurs above 10 reps, evaluate the smallest practical load increase. If failure occurs below 10, hold or reduce. At 10 reps, hold unless broader performance supports an increase.
training_method.logging: Record actual load and reps per set. Track load PRs and rep PRs separately. Do not assign RIR by default.
